name: csv_pivot_inventory_date_keys
query: SELECT root(account, 1) AS type, yearmonth(date) AS month, sum(position) AS total WHERE account ~ '^(Income|Expenses):' AND year = 2017 AND month <= 3 GROUP BY 1, 2 PIVOT BY type, month
notes: Date keys name the pivoted columns as YYYY-MM-DD. numberify then splits each inventory column per currency, so the header is '2017-01-01 (USD)', ... The currency columns of each pivoted column follow the usual numberify order (rows holding the currency, then name descending).
